title: Name the nine bare it.skipIf(win32) Windows skips
notes: Nine bare it.skipIf(process.platform === 'win32') calls have their reason only in a comment, which breaks the 'named it.skipIf' half of workflow-rule-6: create-task-program.test.ts:212,222, board-sync-git.test.ts:200,208, session-socket.test.ts:63,93,141, claude-process.test.ts:14,28. Cost: the reason is lost when a test is copied, and the rule says otherwise. Fix: a named skip per reason, shared from src/main/testing/. Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/375 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/373#discussion_r4694421466

comments.body: Duplicate of card 675ae921, shipped for the same GitHub issue; cancelled.
